Name: FarmHouseExtended (Interior Only)(Working Bathrooms Regen Capable)
Author: QuantumConcious
Description:
=============================================
[size=5][b]FarmHouse Extended (Interior Only) By QuantumConcious[/b][/size]
=============================================

This Mod adds a Basement+Attic+Bathroom [size=2]([size=1][b]Bathroom regens stamina[/b][/size])[/size] to your FarmHouse that gets bigger as a reward for each house upgrade.
This mod is a .XNB edit mod it does not require any mod manager aka Storm or SMAPI.
(Does not work adding these FarmHouse XNB files with Storm or SMAPI, use the following install instructions.)
[size=2][b]If you currently use a custom kitchen retexture mod you should be fine[/b]
[b]Any SMAPI mod that makes changes to the FarmHouse should work fine[/b]

[b][size=4][color=#ff0000]Note:[/color][/size] [/b]Going from 1 iteration to another will have undesired effects, these effects being stuff placed in Basement /Bathroom or Attic of 1 Iteration will not be in the same place on another version(Remove stuff before changing iteration) [/size]
[size=2][b][color=#0000b3]Iteration= Each one of these is a seperate Iteration or Variant of the origional FarmHouseExtended[/color][/b]
[size=2]FarmHouseExtended 1.6[/size]
FarmHouseExtended + FarmCave + SlimeCave Ver1.0
FarmHouse Extended Smaller Basement 1.3
[size=2]FarmHouseExtended Micro Version 1.1[/size]

[/size]
[b]Why not take a look at [color=#0000ff][b]Other mods you might want to Checkout[/b][/color] at the bottom of OP[/b]

[color=#0000b3][b][size=3][b]By downloading my mod you agree to the following:-[/b][/size][/b][/color]
[size=3]- Do not distribute or reupload this content to any site without my strict permission.
- Custom content may not be redistributed or shared without my strict permission, doing so will have me request your mod is taken down. Due to me being the origional creator of the content[/size]


[color=#0000ff][b]Why wall hangings, WallPaper and floortiles can not be changed in the Basement, Attic and Bathroom.[/b][/color]
[SPOILER][b]Note:[/b] This is due to hardcoded code that dictates what can be wallpapered or floortiled or where wall hangings can be placed in the house, this code is only changable in theory via an API like SMAPI or STORM. I have no coding knowledge and can not make this happen.
So due to this fact Wall Hangings eg. Picture frames can not be placed on walls in the Basement, Attic and Bathroom. Wallpapers and floors can not be changed either. Not possible ATM i have no coding skill and this would require coding and the mod to be made SMAPI or Storm compatible and that as i understand is not a easy job.[/SPOILER]

[color=#0000b3][b]Custom Content[/b][/color]
Bathroom decor eg, Bath, Toilet, Basins,Vanity
Credit to [size=3][url='http://community.playstarbound.com/members/taintedwheat.614245/']taintedwheat [/url]and Myself
Checkout her retextures [url='http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/faythes-house-in-the-middle-of-the-street-cute-cool-re-edits.111715/']HERE[/url]
A very big thankyou to you for the textures
[/size]

- FarmHouse1.xnb
- FarmHouse1_marriage.xnb
- FarmHouse2.xnb
- FarmHouse2_marriage.xnb
[b]

[b][b]4) [/b][/b]Place the files in [b]Content[/b] into [b]Content[/b]. Location C:\program files (x86)\steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content ... Overwrite all files.

If you want a different Bathroom A B or C Replace
- FarmHouse2.xnb + FarmHouse2_marriage.xnb
In the Maps Folder with
- FarmHouse2.xnb + FarmHouse2_marriage.xnb
in the corrisponding folders BathRoom A B or C

=======================

[color=#ff0000][b][b]***Recommended for new saves***[/b][/b][/color]
[size=3]Always make a back up of your Saves and your Farm files. You have been warned
These issues at most happen randomly and may be mod related or may even be API related, Only very few get them. Just see if you do if not all good.

[b]- [/b]Very very few people have had an issue with the Dog/Cat dissapearing for x amount of time only to return or not. Be warned not a real issue as the Dog/Cat do nothing,
A fix can be to obtain the Dog/Cat without mod installed then add mod after you have the pet.

- Kids can be found in basement not a real issue they serve no purpose and are just a cosmetic aesthetic NPC.
[/size]
[b]Disclaimer[/b]
[size=3]I hold no responsability if these things happen and you screw up your save. You have been warned and have been informed to Backup your Saves and Farm files.[/size]
